Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''''EOF''''
feat: M0b service readiness — API, worker, schema, contracts, CI

- FastAPI /health/live + /health/ready (PG/Redis/MinIO concurrent probes)
- Celery worker with worker_ready SELECT 1 heartbeat against PG
- Alembic framework + first migration: incidents, diagnosis_runs,
  diagnosis_run_events (zero DB-level FKs per ADR 0003)
- OpenAPI export script + committed openapi.json; frontend schema.ts
  generated via openapi-typescript and committed
- Frontend homepage fetches /health/live server-side and renders JSON
- Makefile real targets (migrate/run-api/run-worker/run-web/gen-openapi)
- GitHub Actions CI: backend, frontend, openapi-drift, integration
- Postgres host port moved to 54320 to avoid clash with local Windows
  postgres.exe on 5432
- Sync SQLAlchemy engine chosen over async due to Windows
  ProactorEventLoop incompatibility with psycopg-async
EOF
)")

feat: M1 data, Ontology v1, and deterministic diagnosis tools

- ArtifactStore protocol + MinIO/Local implementations

  detection, dataset quality validation)
- Tool framework: ToolResult/EvidenceDraft, ToolPolicy (8-call budget,
  fingerprint dedup, read-only), ToolRegistry, EvidenceLedger (EV-NNN)
- Four read-only diagnosis tools with MinIO artifact offload
- 74 tests green (72 unit + 2 MinIO integration); ruff lint+format clean
EOF
)")
